people.name: Ephesus
people.line: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity

translations.web: but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills.” Then he set sail from Ephesus.
translations.bsb: But as he left, he said, “I will come back to you if God is willing.” And he set sail from Ephesus.
translations.kjv: But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that cometh in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus.
translations.asv: but taking his leave of them, and saying, I will return again unto you if God will, he set sail from Ephesus.
